verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs publishes a documented public API reference for Scribe's speech-to-text convert endpoint. It covers parameters such as diarization, timestamps, export formats, webhooks and auth tokens, and adds realtime WebSocket transcription and official Python/Node.js SDKs. Probes confirm machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages) are live. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
